key: HARDY: Back for more, huh?
en: HARDY: Back for more, huh?
ja: ハーディ: また来たのか?

key: You're stubborn-- and I like that.
en: You're stubborn-- and I like that.
ja: お前、頑固だな――そういうとこ好きだぜ。

key: You good to go again?
en: You good to go again?
ja: もう一戦いけそうか?

key: HARDY: What's up, mate?
en: HARDY: What's up, mate?
ja: ハーディ: よぉ、調子どうだ?

key: I've been pumped for this for a while.
en: I've been pumped for this for a while.
ja: これのためにずっとテンション上がってたんだ。

key: You ready to roll?
en: You ready to roll?
ja: 準備はいいか?

key: HARDY: Hell yeah!
en: HARDY: Hell yeah!
ja: ハーディ: よっしゃ!

key: HARDY: You just gotta rock it harder this time, yanno?
en: HARDY: You just gotta rock it harder this time, yanno?
ja: ハーディ: 今度はもっとロックしてもらわないとな、分かるだろ?

key: But I know you didn't get this far by crumbling at the first sign of trouble.
en: But I know you didn't get this far by crumbling at the first sign of trouble.
ja: でもお前が最初のトラブルでへこたれるようなやつじゃないってのは分かってる。

key: Show me what you can do!
en: Show me what you can do!
ja: 何ができるか見せてくれよ!

key: Don't you dare think I'm some kinda pushover like my sister, aite?
en: Don't you dare think I'm some kinda pushover like my sister, aite?
ja: オレを妹みたいな雑魚だと思うなよ、な?

key: There's a reason I'm ranked higher than her.
en: There's a reason I'm ranked higher than her.
ja: オレのほうがランクが上なのには理由があるんだ。

key: Lemme show it to ya in double time!
en: Lemme show it to ya in double time!
ja: 倍速で見せてやるよ!

key: This is gonna rock!
en: This is gonna rock!
ja: こいつはロックするぜ!

key: Heh, looks like I still got a ways to go.
en: Heh, looks like I still got a ways to go.
ja: へっ、オレも　まだまだ　だな

key: HARDY: Looks like I choked after all.
en: HARDY: Looks like I choked after all.
ja: ハーディ: くっ、しくじったか。

key: Welp, Geode Badge is yours, mate.
en: Welp, Geode Badge is yours, mate.
ja: ま、ジオードバッジはお前のもんだ。

key: HARDY: You've earned it.
en: HARDY: You've earned it.
ja: ハーディ: よく頑張ったな。

key: \PN received the Geode Badge!
en: \PN received the Geode Badge!
ja: \PNは「ジオードバッジ」を手に入れた!

key: HARDY: With that bit, your Pokémon are good for up to level 95.
en: HARDY: With that bit, your Pokémon are good for up to level 95.
ja: ハーディ: これで、お前のポケモンはレベル95まで育てられるようになったぜ。

key: Almost to the top, huh?
en: Almost to the top, huh?
ja: あと少しで頂点だな。

key: And peep that TM.
en: And peep that TM.
ja: あと、そのわざマシンも見とけよ。

key: HARDY: Best slide in the world that ain' on a guitar, yanno?
en: HARDY: Best slide in the world that ain' on a guitar, yanno?
ja: ハーディ: ギターに乗ってない中じゃ最高のスライドだぜ、分かるだろ?

key: I bet you can see some use for it.
en: I bet you can see some use for it.
ja: 使いどころ、見えてくるはずだ。

key: Well... I'm countin' on ya to get some good use of it.
en: Well... I'm countin' on ya to get some good use of it.
ja: まあ……うまく使ってくれることを願ってるよ。

key: The final showdown with Meteor pro'lly ain't far off now.
en: The final showdown with Meteor pro'lly ain't far off now.
ja: メテオとの最終決戦も、もうそう遠くないだろうな。

key: An' no matter what, I'mma get Aya back.
en: An' no matter what, I'mma get Aya back.
ja: どうなろうと、オレはアヤを取り戻す。

key: If I gotta beat all of Meteor for it, fine.
en: If I gotta beat all of Meteor for it, fine.
ja: メテオ全員をブッ倒さなきゃならないなら、それでいい。

key: If I gotta beat you for it, I'll do it.
en: If I gotta beat you for it, I'll do it.
ja: お前を倒さなきゃならないなら、そうするさ。

key: You get what I'm sayin'?
en: You get what I'm sayin'?
ja: 分かるだろ?

key: You gotta stay on track to finish the job.
en: You gotta stay on track to finish the job.
ja: お前はこの仕事をやり遂げるために、集中し続けなきゃな。

key: Tch, yeah, I can't wait any longer.
en: Tch, yeah, I can't wait any longer.
ja: チッ、ああ、もう待てねぇ。

key: I'm headin' back to Calcenon right now.
en: I'm headin' back to Calcenon right now.
ja: 今すぐカルセノンに戻る。

key: I'll bust through that barrier one way or another.
en: I'll bust through that barrier one way or another.
ja: どうにかしてあのバリアをぶち破ってやる。

key: And when I do, Team Meteor is through for good!
en: And when I do, Team Meteor is through for good!
ja: そしたら、メテオ団は完全に終わりだ!

key: Catch you there, \PN!
en: Catch you there, \PN!
ja: またそこで会おうぜ、\PN!

key: HARDY: No sweat, mate.
en: HARDY: No sweat, mate.
ja: ハーディ: へっちゃらだぜ。

key: I'm all set whenever you are.
en: I'm all set whenever you are.
ja: お前の準備ができたらいつでもいいぜ。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
